title: Frontend Product Map Preview Confidence Probe v1 Checklist

items.label: Stage the Preview probe WORK room handoff in PLAN handoffInbox and completionQueue.
items.evidenceTarget: PLAN receives handoff-preview-confidence-probe-2026-09-03-01 through the automatic Return Channel.
items.verificationNote: The WORK room pushed the terminal handoff to PLAN task/chat 01a0637c-bc37-7cb1-8655-362695c4c6f7 using send_message_to_thread from WORK task/chat 01a06786-7d05-7be3-b939-8ff6e7917e61. PLAN queued it as arrivalSequence 1.

items.label: Confirm the Preview probe did not edit product behavior.
items.evidenceTarget: The probe remains read-only and returns evidence requirements rather than implementation.
items.verificationNote: The handoff reports no files changed, no behavior changed, and no product edits in Editor, Backend, or Core.

items.label: Record Preview vocabulary and evidence gaps without promoting readiness.
items.evidenceTarget: Draft Preview, stale preview, failed preview, unavailable preview, blocked preview, and Published Preview remain definitions for the next validation lane.
items.verificationNote: The acceptance document keeps Preview separate from WYSIWYG and Publish readiness and names missing Editor, Backend, Core, renderer, artifact, and production-route evidence.

items.label: Recommend the next Preview validation lane.
items.evidenceTarget: The next lane is lane-preview-confidence-validation with parallelLimit 1.
items.verificationNote: The probe recommends starting as evidence-review and allowing Editor product edits only after PLAN explicitly approves a later lane.

items.label: Preserve Progressive Authoring independence boundary.
items.evidenceTarget: Progressive Authoring may proceed independently only while bounded to managed cards/text islands and treating Preview as unavailable or diagnostic-only.
items.verificationNote: If Progressive Authoring relies on Preview freshness, PDF artifacts, or Published Preview parity, it should wait for Preview validation evidence.
